title: Nvidia Board Prepares to Dismiss CEO Jensen Huang
excerpt: Nvidia's board is reportedly preparing to fire CEO Jensen Huang following reports of alleged extramarital affairs.
body_html: Nvidia's board is reportedly preparing to dismiss Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang. This development follows reports regarding alleged extramarital affairs involving the CEO. According to reports, the board's preparation to remove Huang comes just days after he admitted to an affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy, alongside a separate report detailing a second alleged affair with an executive.
